purpose: generalize confirmed findings into reusable prevention rules

families.rootCause: same-looking literals belonged to different owner semantics and contract vocabulary
families.fix: classify every occurrence, use owner-local constants, and let only the service-node set flow through OpenAPI/codegen
families.prevention: RP-12 five-set denominator plus per-occurrence mapping and real red mutation
families.counterexample: generated catalogs remain source-owned and are not manually replaced

families.rootCause: transport/storage failure was collapsed into a successful negative answer
families.fix: classify explicit not-found responses and propagate every other failure as unavailable
families.counterexample: only a provider-confirmed missing object may return false

families.rootCause: list response materialized relation detail that the list contract does not need
families.fix: separate summary and detail read models
families.prevention: HeadCompanySummary wire type and list/detail focused proof
families.counterexample: detail/explicit expansion can still load authorizedBrands

families.rootCause: multiple writers could emit subtly different JSON shape or escaping
families.fix: one strict audit-model writer with validation
families.prevention: all production audit INSERT sites route through AuditChangeJson.write
families.counterexample: edge does not persist or reserialize audit payloads

families.rootCause: contract error vocabulary outlived owner behavior and silently advertised an impossible path
families.fix: prove owner reachability first, then remove only the dead declaration and regenerate
families.counterexample: reachable owner behavior must be added rather than hidden by UI filtering

families.rootCause: invalid pagination parameter shared the account-not-found concealment path
families.fix: typed PageValidationException for parameter errors while retaining concealment for visibility
families.prevention: focused page-size proof and advice mapping
families.counterexample: account existence must not be revealed by parameter validation

families.rootCause: identical hierarchy collation lived in two apps
families.fix: export one foundation collator and keep app shell/copy/feature ownership local
families.prevention: foundation import boundary and focused app tests
families.counterexample: app-specific labels, problems and shells do not move to foundation

families.rootCause: a cross-owner read existed in code without a registry edge
families.fix: declare a query-only task-read dependency with referenced owner relation
families.counterexample: no write, lock, transaction or FK authority is implied

families.rootCause: SELECT * wrappers made read shape implicit and fragile
families.fix: name the projection once and reuse it in list/require wrappers

families.rootCause: presentation catalog retained identity fields that the page context already supplied
families.fix: reconcile the owner catalog against the actual page and keep only business-relevant identity
families.counterexample: removing a redundant display column does not remove owner filtering or detail capability

families.rootCause: historical hashes and phase names were treated as current source truth
families.fix: record source-owned authority drift, add explicit phase aliases, and preserve canonical commands
families.prevention: standards coverage alias and explicit ST-11/heritage dispositions
families.counterexample: do not silently refresh historical evidence or create a second budget gate

families.rootCause: a fail-closed type guard sits inside an assignment filter, so retiring a stored vocabulary value changes the failure scope from one hidden assignment to whole-session creation
families.fix: retain fail-closed unknown-value behavior and require owner/data migration plus stale-row proof before removing a supported value
families.prevention: retirement checklist: migration, zero-stale-row scan, focused login proof, and only then ServiceNodeTypes set change
families.counterexample: a genuinely unknown or tampered value must still fail closed rather than be silently accepted

reusableChecklist: re-read source and evidence before exit
authorizationBoundary: Evidence only; no runtime, environment, database, seed/reset, deployment or Git authority.
